d: India is showcasing next-generation drone technology at Drone Expo 2026 in New Delhi, with military, AI-powered and civilian drones on display at Yashobhoomi. More than 100 exhibitors from over 12 countries are participating, featuring kamikaze, VTOL, loitering, interceptor and autonomous drones alongside agricultural and disaster-relief applications. Meanwhile, Bangkok has been hit by devastating floods after record rainfall, submerging streets and triggering evacuations and emergency response efforts. Hem Kaur Saroya explains both developments on Vantage on Firstpost.
